interview_research.summary: The Spotify Backend Engineer II interview process in Stockholm began with a recruiter phone call, followed by a technical video call with two engineers, a non-technical online test, and an on-site interview of four rounds plus lunch, ending with an offer from HR.
No public information about the interview process was found.
